items.title: Make the startup brief a self-validating projection of current project truth instead of an ordered dump of historical receipts.
items.why: PROJECT_STATUS.testingSurfaces is append-only, while renderTestItNow slices the first eight entries; the live brief therefore shows 685/685 as the Unit tests target while the same brief and PROJECT_STATUS report 737/737. The cost tile can also render a red alarm in modelPlanMode even though the founder contract says Max Plan cost is notional and non-alarming.
items.recipe: Add a pure testing-surface selector that keeps stable endpoint classes but chooses the newest receipt per volatile class, prioritizes current status tests/deploy evidence, and preserves explicit history outside the eight-row brief. Add a plan-aware cost presenter that never alarms on flat-rate Max Plan notional values. Extend brief validation with source-coherence assertions for test counts, selected surfaces, cost semantics, and profile metadata; then regenerate and exact-test the brief.

L1.recipe: Select the newest tests receipt and neutralize Max Plan cost alarms.

L2.recipe: Create pure surface/cost presenters with unit tests and integrate the renderer.

L3.recipe: Add cross-source brief validation, duplicate/staleness invariants, explicit provenance, regression fixtures, and regenerate the canonical brief.

items.title: Turn the last seconds of a run into a bounded damage-sequence receipt that explains observed burst versus attrition.
items.why: Current death handling records one likely killer and the pressure arc but does not retain hit timing, damage class, health transition, or the final multi-source sequence. That makes the next-run coaching less actionable and hides whether the player was deleted by a burst, chipped down, or crossed a hazard while pressured.
items.recipe: Create a pure fixed-memory damage-sequence recorder and finalizer; route every player-damage path through one observed-damage boundary without changing damage math, invulnerability, random-number draws, or controller/input behavior. Persist only sanitized bounded facts in run history, derive burst/attrition/mixed labels from explicit frame/health thresholds, surface one plain-language DeathScreen timeline plus a Balance Lab aggregate, and cover every damage class with invariant tests.

L1.recipe: Define the bounded recorder/finalizer and exact burst/attrition tests.

L2.recipe: Wire projectile, contact, boss, hazard, and mine damage paths through the receipt boundary and persist it.

L3.recipe: Add player-facing timeline, Balance Lab aggregation, migration-safe normalization, accessibility copy, and launch/replay regression coverage.

items.recipe: Replace the eager Supabase singleton with a memoized async getSupabaseClient() boundary and update every network-backed call site while preserving synchronous local storage APIs and offline fallback. Add race/failure tests, ensure one client instance under concurrency, keep MenuScreen presence cleanup correct, and assert the production manifest no longer statically imports either optional vendor from the entry chunk; record exact raw/gzip deltas.

L3.recipe: Cover concurrency/failure/offline semantics, lazy presence teardown, build-manifest assertions, and measured entry-load deltas.
